snippet.title: [Trailer] Sonic of the Ring Tutorials Room v0.6 Update - Fan Game
snippet.description:
Finally, it's almost five years to develop this project.

This game still has many shortcomings in version 0.6, this is still an imperfect game category in general normal games in Sonic Fan Game which means it is not similar to slope and loop. This game has references such as Sonic 06, Sonic Unleashed, Sonic Colors and Sonic Generations.

I hope Sonic of the Ring Tutorials Room Version 0.6 will hopefully be released soon this year.

Thank you for watching.
Sonic of the Ring Tutorials Room Version 0.6 Update
